summary: The technical deep‑dive call on 16 Sep 2026 included Sneha (SE), Aditya Reddy (VP Engineering), Kavya Srinivasan (CISO) and Rahul (AE). Aditya confirmed the solution meets their July requirement, while Kavya raised security compliance needs for SOC 2 Type II and data residency within India. Rahul promised to send the SOC 2 documentation immediately after the call. The team also discussed pricing pressure, with Aditya noting Priya’s request to match Stratify’s price, indicating a potential hurdle before the next meeting on 30 Sep 2026.
